candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
Multiple asymptomatic nodules without ulceration on upper arms
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
enlarged axillary, cervical, and inguinal lymph nodes and enlarged spleen
uveitis
candidates.why: The combination of skin, joint, and eye symptoms along with lymph node and spleen enlargement and the presence of acid-fast bacilli suggests Sarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
support_spans: Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
X-ray and joint ultrasound showed: osteoarthritis, synovitis, flexor tendon tenosynovitis, and bone erosions
contradict_spans: Normal results for: C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide
candidates.why: The presence of joint symptoms and significantly elevated rheumatoid factor supports Rheumatoid Arthritis, but normal CRP and anti-CCP levels are less typical.

candidates.name: Leprosy
support_spans: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
contradict_spans: No decreased sensation to pain, temperature and/or touch
candidates.why: The hair loss and presence of acid-fast bacilli could suggest Leprosy, but the lack of sensory changes is atypical.

candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
Multiple asymptomatic nodules without ulceration on upper arms
Numerous acid-fast bacilli not typically seen, but diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis
candidates.why: The combination of skin and joint symptoms, along with the specific findings of diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes and numerous acid-fast bacilli, suggests Sarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
support_spans: Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: 27 mm/h (slightly elevated)
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
contradict_spans: Normal results for: C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide
candidates.why: The presence of swollen and painful hand joints, elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and significantly elevated rheumatoid factor supports Rheumatoid Arthritis, but normal results for other inflammatory markers and specific autoantibodies weaken this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Leprosy
support_spans: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
candidates.why: The gradual hair loss and presence of numerous acid-fast bacilli are consistent with Leprosy, which can cause skin and hair symptoms, as well as peripheral nerve damage, although the latter is not reported here.
